The `eval` does not involve untrusted input or external downloads, and it only creates simple wrapper functions. Since `makepkg --printsrcinfo` only sources the PKGBUILD and does not execute any build or packaging functions, this `eval` is safe in context.

No network operations, file exfiltration, or execution of downloaded payloads occur during sourcing. All values are derived from hardcoded or versioned upstream sources, and no obfuscated or suspicious code is present at the top level.
